title: A voicing track in a score without chords plays nothing, silently
description: Found while testing envelopes (apricitus-9df78b): a pitched track with `voicing root|power|triad|seventh` in a score that has no `chords` line (only `bars N`) compiles cleanly but produces 0 events, so it renders silence with no error or warning. Repro: tempo 120 / key C major / bars 4 / clip horn = marine-band/stems/Thunderer/other.wav seconds 85.38..86.95 root F4 / track horn voicing root steps "x . . . . . . . x . . . . . . .". The pitched-note path looks up the active chord span and returns early when there is none. Fix: either voice the key's tonic chord (I or i) when there are no chords, or make it a compile error naming the fix ("voicing needs chords; add a chords line, or use notes"). Decide which; add a test either way.
